content: Multi-BERT has showcased its ability to enable cross-lingual zero-shot learning on the natural language understanding tasks including XNLI BIBREF19, NER, POS, Dependency Parsing, and so on. We now seek to know if a pre-trained multi-BERT has ability to solve RC tasks in the zero-shot setting.
